title: Interpleader: competing demands on one obligation
shortTitle: Interpleader: competing demands on one obligation
summary: Interpleader allows a stakeholder facing competing demands for the same property or obligation to bring the claimants into one proceeding. It protects against inconsistent obligations while providing a process to decide entitlement.
notes: Interpleader does not combine all related liabilities into one fund. Tashire limits an injunction to the stakeholder problem rather than permitting control over every accident claim.

sections.Meaning: Interpleader allows a stakeholder facing competing demands for the same property or obligation to bring the claimants into one proceeding. It protects against inconsistent obligations while providing a process to decide entitlement.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the fund or obligation, the competing claimants, and whether the stakeholder faces double payment or multiple liability. Choose between the applicable state procedure, Federal Rule 22, and statutory interpleader, then check that route’s jurisdiction and service requirements.
